cases.question: Why do Hindi refund tickets wait so long and what fixes it?
cases.answer: Hindi refund tickets wait 13.0 times longer compared to other tickets, with a mean wait time of 368 minutes versus 28 minutes. The issue is attributed to the lack of Hindi-speaking agents who are capable of handling refund and payment failure tickets. To address this, cross-training 2 Hindi-speaking agents on payment failure and refund is proposed, which is expected to reduce missed promises by 131 over the 14 held-out days (likely between 88 and 174 fewer). [1][2][3]

cases.question: How long do Hindi refund tickets wait compared with other tickets?
cases.answer: Hindi × Team B wait 13.0× longer. For this group the mean wait (min) is 368; for normal tickets it is 28. It affects 4,345 tickets (5.38% of all). [1][3]

cases.question: How many missed promises does cross-training Hindi agents save?
cases.answer: Cross-training two Hindi-speaking agents on payment failure and refund saves between 88 and 174 fewer missed promises over the 14 held-out days, according to the data from Source [1].

cases.question: If we apply every recommended fix at once how many missed promises do we save?
cases.answer: All 18 measured fixes together save 574 fewer missed promises over the 14 held-out days (likely between 505 and 643 fewer). [1]

cases.question: How much better is OpsLens than skills-based routing?
cases.answer: OpsLens misses 8.79% of promises vs 20.74% for industry-standard skills routing, showing a significant improvement. [2][3]

cases.question: What is the refund rule for a missing item above 300 rupees?
cases.answer: For orders above Rs 300, a photo of the bag and receipt sticker is required, and the refund is processed only after it is checked. [1][2]

cases.question: How long does a refund to a card or UPI take to arrive?
cases.answer: Refunds to cards and UPI take 5 to 7 working days. If a refund was started more than 7 working days ago, raise it to the payments team with the order ID and give the customer a reference number. [1][2][3]

cases.question: What happens when money was deducted but the order failed?
cases.answer: If money left the customer's account but the order did not go through, it comes back automatically within 48 hours. Ask the customer not to pay again for the same order unless they want to. If 48 hours have passed, raise it to the payments team with the transaction reference. [1]

cases.question: Which team is short of people at weekday dinner?
cases.answer: Team C is overloaded on weekday dinner, which is indicated by the work ÷ agent-time (rho) being 1.31, compared to 1 for normal tickets. The self-serve instant refund on weekday dinner (Team C) resulted in 74 fewer missed promises over the 14 held-out days. [1][2]

cases.question: How many tickets are affected by the phone menu problem?
cases.answer: The phone menu problem affects 16,272 tickets (20.15% of all). [1]

cases.question: How many of the planted problems did OpsLens find?
cases.answer: OpsLens found 4/5 of the planted problems in the initial data, and 86.7% of the planted problems in the live detection of the unseen day-47 surge. [1][3]

cases.question: What is the risk model's AUC on the test days?
cases.answer: The risk model's AUC on the test days is 0.973. [1]

cases.question: How fast is the team queue query with a million tickets?
cases.answer: The team queue (agent's view) query with a million tickets has a median time of 3.65 ms. [1]

cases.question: Does the local AI beat the cloud AI at reading tickets on its own?
cases.answer: On its own, the local model is almost as good as the cloud one, scoring 90.75% for classification accuracy, compared to 91.5% for the cloud model. However, the local model performs better when it is used in conjunction with routing, achieving 97.51% accuracy, which is higher than the cloud model's 98.22% accuracy. [1][2]

cases.question: What range does the Hindi cross-training fix have?
cases.answer: The cross-training fix for Hindi-speaking agents resulted in 131 fewer missed promises over the 14 held-out days, with a likely range of 88 to 174 fewer. [1][2][3]

cases.question: How many missed promises does the status banner fix save?
cases.answer: The status banner fix saves between 38 and 83 fewer missed promises over the 14 held-out days, with a likely reduction of 61 fewer missed promises. [1][2]
